patterns.note: The homepage employs an extreme minimalist layout, featuring only a large logo and typographic hero, relying heavily on scroll-triggered motion to reveal subsequent content.
Extreme contrast in type scale, with massive, bold sans-serif display headings (~8-10x body) and very small, light sans-serif text used for navigation and body content.
A stark monochromatic palette dominated by black text and elements on a pure white background, allowing any imagery to provide the only color accents.
The initial large, centered logo shrinks and moves to become a central element within a newly revealed sticky top navigation bar as the user scrolls.
The massive hero text scrolls upwards and simultaneously blurs and fades out, making way for a new, smaller, static text element ('THAT'S ALL FOLKS!') to appear centered on the screen.
Project pages feature full-bleed imagery interspersed with concise, centered text blocks, creating a dynamic visual narrative with ample negative space.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-driven animation system (likely locomotive-scroll) to orchestrate a multi-stage hero transformation: the initial hero text scrolls and blurs away, the main logo shrinks and repositions, and a new sticky navigation bar with the transformed logo and a new text element ('THAT'S ALL FOLKS!') appears.
The header navigation dynamically transforms from a sparse initial state to a compact, sticky bar with the logo integrated, appearing after the initial hero scroll.

Content sections on interior pages, such as images and text blocks, are revealed with subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animations as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic but smooth reading experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif hero headings (~8-10x body) with small, light sans-serif navigation and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy on the homepage and initial sections, transitioning to a balanced density with generous padding around content blocks on interior project pages.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extreme minimalist homepage, which acts as a dramatic, interactive typographic reveal. Instead of a traditional hero image, it uses massive, animated text and a transforming logo to create an immediate sense of sophisticated, motion-driven design, culminating in a stark 'THAT'S ALL FOLKS!' statement before revealing the client list.
